destination.title: Can pure supergravity stand alone?
destination.question: Under which conditions can a specified pure supergravity spectrum admit quantum completion or be isolated from its proposed string origin while retaining gravitational interactions?
destination.summary: Separate decoupling, perturbative finiteness, nonperturbative states and compatibility of inherited interactions. Each is a different test of a proposed standalone theory.

An incomplete supersymmetrization analysis does not establish general inconsistency
conventions: N=8 and scalar-free N=2 questions are not fine identities
excludes: A claimed general proof that pure N=8 supergravity is inconsistent
Nongravitational decoupling as the same physical limit

sources.title: String Universality in Six Dimensions

evidence.text: Use group trace identities to remove irreducible tr F^4 anomalies, then solve Green–Schwarz factorization of the remaining polynomial. For the worked model the irreducible constraints are M−BN=8 and 2N−A(N−8)−BM=0.

sources.title: TASI Lectures on Supergravity and String Vacua in Various Dimensions

evidence.text: Green–Schwarz anomaly cancellation uses factorization of anomaly polynomials and exchange of two-form fields. In 6D, I8 = ½ Ωαβ X4α X4β with Ω of signature (1,T). Legible constraints include H−V = 273−29T, a·a = 9−T, and proper-sign gauge kinetic terms requiring j·bi > 0.

evidence.text: Which discrete choices distinguish components of string moduli space with sixteen supersymmetries, primarily in seven or more dimensions, and which string/M/F theory descriptions realize the same component?

evidence.text: Determine the moduli-space components, weakly coupled limits and DLCQ M(atrix) descriptions of reduced-rank nine-dimensional M/string backgrounds preserving 16 supercharges.

sources.title: Wormholes in Maximal Supergravity

evidence.text: Select a noncompact geodesic generator instead of restricting to nilpotent scalar translations. Check absence of fixed points, identify its cyclic coordinate, reverse that coordinate's metric sign, and take a finite timelike segment long enough for the wormhole boundary conditions.

sources.title: Global Aspects of Moduli Spaces of 2d SCFTs

evidence.text: Construct root gerbes using trivializable roots of the fiberwise canonical bundle, an atlas with a square-root torsor of relations, and a fiber product with the squaring map on the classifying stack of C*. Compare the resulting groupoids and universal bundles.

sources.title: All eight- and nine-dimensional string vacua from junctions

evidence.text: Construct electric character and magnetic cocharacter lattices from zero-asymptotic-charge physical junctions modulo global integer null loops. Extract the non-Abelian quotient as Z=Jfrac^(N,mag)/Jint^(N,mag), and the quotient involving Abelian factors from Z′=PA(Jphys^mag)/JA^mag.

sources.title: String dualities and modular symmetries in supergravity: a review

evidence.text: The N=2 analysis uses symplectic sections, electric-magnetic frame changes, monodromies, and modular third derivatives of the one-loop prepotential. Gauge-enhancement singularities and perturbative asymptotics constrain the resulting modular functions.

sources.title: Triples, fluxes, and strings

evidence.text: Analyze commuting holonomies through centralizers and extended Dynkin diagrams; use bundle topology and Chern–Simons invariants to distinguish flat-connection components. The centralizer classification used here is imported from earlier mathematical work.

sources.title: The Moduli space and M(atrix) theory of 9d N=1 backgrounds of M/string theory

evidence.text: Obtain the Klein-bottle DLCQ theory from an auxiliary small spacelike circle and two T-dualities. Derive the D2 action and boundary conditions using orientifold projections, supersymmetry, boundary-term cancellation and anomaly requirements.

sources.title: Gauged D=9 supergravities and Scherk-Schwarz reduction

evidence.text: Which inequivalent nine-dimensional gauged theories arise from twisted circle reductions of IIB supergravity and string theory, and how do monodromy conjugacy classes determine their gaugings and allowed parameters?

sources.title: New supersymmetric string moduli spaces from frozen singularities

evidence.text: Can inequivalent configurations with the same frozen ADE singularity type define disconnected moduli spaces of theories with sixteen supercharges, distinguished by lattice data and global gauge topology? Can their decompactification patterns predict an additional nine-dimensional rank-one theory?

sources.title: Compactness of brane moduli and the String Lamppost Principle in d > 6

evidence.text: Can compactness, connectedness, and local field-theory data of small-instanton brane moduli reconstruct internal string geometries and establish the String Lamppost Principle for supersymmetric gravity in dimensions seven through nine, with an extension toward six dimensions?

sources.title: TASI Lectures on Supergravity and String Vacua in Various Dimensions

evidence.text: How strongly does quantum consistency constrain low-energy supersymmetric theories coupled to gravity, and how closely do those constraints match known string constructions in dimensions 10, 8, and 6?

sources.title: String universality

evidence.text: Can the five perturbative string theories and 11D supergravity share a central domain with identical 4D low energy physics, and can duality-related boundary descriptions constrain moduli stabilization, supersymmetry breaking, and phenomenology there?

sources.title: Symmetry points of $ \mathcal{N}=1 $ modular geometry

evidence.text: How far can modular symmetry alone identify critical points and generically classify their vacuum energy in four-dimensional N=1 supergravity, while constraining weak-coupling potential asymptotics through metric positivity and imposed Swampland criteria?

sources.title: New supersymmetric string theories from discrete theta angles

evidence.text: When do discrete theta angles define physically distinct quantum gravities with identical massless supergravity, and how do they change massive spectra, dualities and BPS completeness in compactifications with sixteen supercharges?

sources.title: The landscape and the swampland of O(3,3) gauged supergravities

evidence.text: Which seven-dimensional half-maximal O(3,3) gaugings admit exact type II freely acting orbifold realizations, and how do string consistency conditions restrict their continuous gauging parameters?

sources.title: Distinguishing off-shell supergravities with on-shell physics

evidence.text: Can off-shell completions of four-dimensional N=1 supergravity that agree locally on shell be distinguished by global supersymmetric compactifications or physical boundary degrees of freedom?

sources.title: Anatomy of a top-down approach to discrete and modular flavor symmetry

evidence.text: How does a heterotic string construction determine the complete flavor symmetry and its breaking, and which restrictions might this impose on bottom-up discrete and modular flavor models?

sources.title: Bounds on discrete gauge symmetries in supergravity

evidence.text: What upper bounds constrain finite cyclic gauge symmetries acting on massless moduli at enhanced-symmetry loci in supergravity with at least eight supercharges, and which bounds are attained by string constructions?

sources.title: The geometry of hypermultiplets

evidence.text: Review the geometry of hypermultiplets coupled to supergravity, its realization in string compactifications, and whether negative-curvature quaternion-Kähler geometry suffices for a string realization or admits swampland examples.

sources.title: Quantum Gravity Principles for 4d $\mathcal{N}=2$ Supergravity Theories and Asymptotic Hodge Theory

evidence.text: Which asymptotic properties of 4d N=2 vector multiplet moduli spaces follow from supersymmetry alone, and which require quantum gravity input concerning light towers, charge completeness and compatible gravitational duality frames?
